items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: his name is Lawrence Lucey, and he has a music studio and he's teaching chords and all that stuff now. Well, he was with Fletcher's band during that time.

ctx.x: Without the piano, and of course, if there was an important thing where the piano had to play chimes, or bells, or make modulations, he'd do that and jump right back up from the piano. And he had a guitarist with him that was an excellent guitarist -- John Collins. Do you remember that name? He was a legend, and he's still in New York, and he had another guitarist that -- I just scrapped a 'Down Beat' here the other day -- his name is Lawrence Lucey, and he has a music studio and he's teaching chords and all that…
days, you know, the string bass. But it was missed, but he had to do it, and I knew this, and it kept him busy.
